name.full: FoundRole AI Job Search and Application Tracker

description.short: AI job search and application tracker with pay, visa and ghost-job checks.
description.full:
Search live job postings by role, employer, location, pay, posting date and work mode. FoundRole can help clarify a role, employer or location before searching. Postings can include pay comparisons, ghost-job signals and past visa sponsorship records.

Review how hiring software reads a resume, see what your saved experience says about fit for a job, preview a tailoring change or start a cover letter. The preview runs in the conversation and can link to the selected job and resume in FoundRole.

Save jobs in your application tracker, manage notes and status, set follow-up reminders, and get email alerts from a saved search.

Sign in to FoundRole through the assistant. Reading saved personal content uses the permissions you approved when connecting.

agentConnectors.description: Searches FoundRole jobs, previews resume fit and tailoring, checks how hiring software reads a resume, and manages applications, reminders and alerts.
